user.title: Flo Detect
user.description: Adds Flo Detect water-use events for the devices of a Flo account that is already set up in Home Assistant. It uses that account's sign-in, so no credentials are needed.

data_description.flo_entry_id: The Flo integration entry whose devices report Flo Detect events.

abort.already_configured: Flo Detect is already set up for this Flo account.
abort.flo_not_loaded: Set up the Flo integration first, then add Flo Detect.

flo_entry_missing.message: The Flo config entry this Flo Detect entry belongs to no longer exists. Remove Flo Detect and add it again.

flo_not_loaded.message: The Flo integration is not loaded yet.
